articles.title: About this site
articles.description: I am an eager walker in real life, it makes me think and clears my thoughts; but what I like even more is to walk with my mind and track my experiences. I hope this blog makes you think and motivates you to do small extraordinary things in life. Be humble and proud of yourself!

articles.title: Walk on the Wild Side
articles.description: Welcome to the Mind Walker blog, be ready to walk and to be surprised.
articles.contents:
She says, “Hey babe, take a walk on the wild side”

Mind-blowing.
